title: BEACON Shelter Registry
description: Validates config/shelters.json (ADR-012 'config for everything'; FR-8, SPEC §5.5). The agency-seeded shelter list an operator edits BY HAND — adding, opening, closing or re-capacitating a shelter is one entry here plus `npm run db:seed`, with no UI and no code change. It is not the only editable surface: once seeded, a live correction (`UPDATE shelter SET occupancy = ... WHERE id = ...`) is equally supported and is what an operator uses mid-incident; this file is the reproducible starting state. Every entry is re-validated through the DOMAIN factory `makeShelter` on load, so a file that violates a shelter invariant (occupancy above capacity, a FULL shelter with room left) fails at boot rather than seeding a shelter that lies about its own headroom.

$schema.description: Editor hint; ignored by the loader.

$comment.description: Human note; ignored by the loader.

version.description: Registry format version. Bumped only for a breaking shape change.

regions.description: Shelters grouped by the operating region that runs them, in registry order.

region_id.description: A region id from config/regions.json. GROUPING ONLY, and deliberately so: the `shelter` table has no region column (schema/logistics-tables.ts), exactly as `source_record` has none, so this cannot be a persisted scope and is not presented as one. It is how an operator finds the shelters they are responsible for.

shelters.description: The region's shelters. An empty list would be indistinguishable from a config typo — remove the region group instead.

id.description: The shelter's uuid PRIMARY KEY — lowercase hex, because `shelter.id` is a uuid column and a friendlier id would be rejected by the DB. It is stable on purpose: re-seeding is idempotent (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING) and a direct UPDATE targets this id.

note.description: Operator-facing name/landmark for THIS FILE only, e.g. 'Sacramento — Cal Expo'. Ignored by the loader and never persisted: the Shelter entity has no name field, and inventing one here would put a label on screen that no column can keep true (finding F-406).

org.description: The agency operating the shelter (persisted to `shelter.org`).

lon.description: Longitude, decimal degrees WGS84. Named rather than positional: a hand-edited [lat,lon] swap puts a shelter in the wrong hemisphere and still validates.

capacity.description: Total headcount the site can hold.

occupancy.description: Current headcount. MUST NOT exceed capacity (chk_shelter_occupancy_le_capacity; re-checked by makeShelter at load).

status.description: Only OPEN shelters with spare capacity are offered as evacuation destinations. FULL requires occupancy == capacity, or the status lies about the site.
